policy.profile_storage: Each accepted parser profile is an immutable strict-UTF-8 JSON document with no BOM, retained in the PatentGrantBundle as evidence/identity/sha256/<sha256-of-exact-profile-bytes>.

required_semantics.edition_scope: exact edition or fail-closed bounded edition set
required_semantics.input_encoding: exact byte-to-character rules with malformed-input rejection
required_semantics.field_mapping: complete deterministic mapping to jurisdiction_code, record_kind, assigned, canonical_name and parent_code
required_semantics.normalization: all permitted normalization steps in exact order
required_semantics.rejection_rules: conditions that must fail rather than guess

policy.trust_binding: An accepted ISO trust-anchor/edition rule must name the exact parser_profile_id and parser_profile_sha256 for the authenticated source media type and edition scope.
policy.release_binding: The signed identity attestation and release record must bind the exact parser-registry version/hash and parser-profile id/hash; the exact registry/profile bytes are retained in the bundle.
policy.note: No locally named, ambient, latest, implementation-defined, or unlisted parser is conforming. This registry intentionally contains no parser profiles until an authenticated ISO source format and a deterministic reviewed parser for it are available.
